title: Data unavailable
heading: No current {{name}} reading
body: PondFix has no recent reading for {{name}} in {{pond}}. Missing data is shown as unavailable. It is not treated as healthy or normal.

step.power: Check that the sensor has power and is switched on.
step.cable: Check that the sensor cable and the gateway are connected.
step.display: Check the sensor’s own display, if it has one, for an error.
step.signal: Make sure the gateway or network has signal, then try again.
step.admin: If the problem continues, contact your system administrator.

stillNone_one: Still no reading after {{count}} check. The server has not received a newer reading for this parameter.
stillNone_other: Still no reading after {{count}} checks. The server has not received a newer reading for this parameter.
retryHint: Checks this device again. It does not create a reading.
